notes.title: How the "map" works in The Devil's Due
notes.notes: [p]For the map sequence, we wanted to try something a bit different from the standard roguelite branching paths. We think the result perfectly captures the game’s cheeky, cheating vibe.[/p][previewyoutube="KGg35uZ_pjI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Balatro meets Hades in The Devil's Due, a poker deckbuilder where cheaters win
notes.notes:
They say that cheaters never prosper, but in The Devil's Due, it's the only way you're going to save yourself from Hell. This deckbuilder sees your cowboy losing his soul to the Devil in a poker match, and the only escape is to put together the most dishonest, low-down dirty deck of cards you can.
